evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies MempoolInfoToJSON in src/rpc/mempool.cpp to optimize getmempoolinfo.
rationale: Avoids an unnecessary copy of the unbroadcast transaction ID set under lock when calling getmempoolinfo. Microbenchmarks show this reduces query time from ~0.9 ms to ~22.6 ns at 10,000 unbroadcast entries, preventing lock-held heap allocations on a frequently polled RPC.
